summary: T26 DSH integration. New runtime/application.mjs is the composition root (construct vs start per W08, minimal-port injection per W07, reverse disposer teardown, storage-degraded keeps diagnostics only), host/dsh.mjs adapts injected host seams into the validated HostPort (missing capabilities are typed UNSUPPORTED, never fake success) and plugin-entry.mjs is the DSH plugin (name=dsh-notifier, ctx.provide(notifierV1, facade), notify/notify_test/ask_user with trusted-context-only scope/actor). New test/integration/application.test.mjs covers assembly, host call shapes, tools, attachments and teardown order. Also fixed a real bug: NOT_READY (required by 18-WIRING) was missing from ERROR_CODES. Honest simplifications: dsh.mjs adapts an injected seam bundle rather than the real DSH module loader, and native approval/user-question waterfall interceptors are not registered. Verification: npm run check passes (81 source files); npm test 495 pass / 0 fail.
